## Row

```{python}
#| title: Top 15 Topics & Regions
from google.cloud import bigquery
import plotly.express as px

client = bigquery.Client(project="portfolio-hub-464520")

# Aggregate the unnested counts across all available dates
df = client.query("""
    select category_name, sum(article_count) as total_articles
    from `portfolio-hub-464520.dbt_dev.mart_category_totals`
    group by category_name
    order by total_articles desc
    limit 15
""").to_dataframe()

fig = px.bar(
    df, 
    x="category_name", 
    y="total_articles",
    color="total_articles",
    color_continuous_scale="Teal",
    labels={"category_name": "Category", "total_articles": "Article Count"}
)

fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_tickangle=-45,
    xaxis_title=None,
    yaxis_title="Number of Articles",
    showlegend=False
)
fig.show()
```
